author: Springger
text:
Once again, I've spent some screen time and lo and behold, on the daily charts are quite a few, bouncing price between S/D. From far right, in the red, shows what appears to be a failed quasimodo. However, after the LL, price compressed back up to the daily S area, drawn in with white paint, before it shot back down to demand. To the right of that, drawn in on both green and blue are two others, firstly at demand which pushed price back to supply, and the opposite which shoved it back down. To the extreme right, in yellow appears what might be another quasimodo forming, time will tell.

At this point, its no surprise that with more and more homework being done, its surely getting easier to spot them.

And here is the chart BTW......
